title: Among Us Role Reveal
blurb: In Among Us, that ominous shimmer told you whether you were crewmate or impostor, and it played over the single most consequential second of the match. Through 2020 it sounded in roughly ten million bedrooms a night, and that is how a small indie game's UI sting turned into a permanent cultural reference. It now works for any secret identity surfacing — the friend who was leaking the group chat all along, the colleague who booked the meeting. Everything before this sound is speculation. Everything after it is strategy.
origin: From Among Us's game-start role assignment screen (InnerSloth, 2018).
